title: E-MTH-0006: a coarse conservation test is blind exactly when the block tiles whole periods of the destroyed quantity...
purpose: Experiment E-MTH-0006 in the method arena: a coarse conservation test is blind exactly when the block tiles whole periods of the destroyed quantity AND that quantity sums to zero over a period, which refutes the simpler commensurability guess.
